column1: BARCLAY'S BEST BUDDY SELECTION PROCESS — DAVE'S DOG CENTER
BARCLAY'S CHOICE — animal-agency adaptation of the Legacy-wide awards process

column3: Controlled Requirement

Best Trainer: people who materially trained Barclay during the evaluation period. Best Comfort Buddy: people with an established ordinary companionship relationship with Barclay. No one is eligible merely because of title, ownership, family relationship, donor status or visibility.
column6: Barclay freely approaches or re-approaches the person without pressure.
column7: Being carried/placed next to someone; blocked alternatives; repeated calling until he complies.

column3: Confirm humane, safe treatment. Serious verified coercive, frightening, painful, reckless or welfare-compromising conduct makes the person ineligible for the cycle.
column6: Loose comfortable posture, settled presence, normal breathing/behavior, ability to rest or disengage.
column7: Freezing, avoidance, appeasement, shutdown or stillness misread as comfort.

column3: Nominees and supporters may not campaign to Barclay, repeatedly call him, monopolize him, stage interactions, create distress, or use special access/rewards to manufacture preference.
column6: Barclay chooses to remain near, follow, return to or settle with the person when alternatives exist.
column7: Leash restraint, closed-door confinement or food positioning treated as preference.

column3: Observe Barclay across multiple ordinary interactions in familiar, low-pressure settings. Do not stage a head-to-head contest between nominees.
column6: Willing interaction appropriate to the relationship—training, play, touch or quiet companionship.
column7: Forced touch, crowding, repeated commands during a comfort observation, staged excitement/distress.
column8: Barclay may disengage at any time.

column3: Record voluntary approach, proximity, relaxed body language, willingness to remain/return, comfortable engagement, recovery after stimulation, responsiveness and freely chosen interaction. One isolated moment does not control the result.
column6: Barclay accepts guidance or comfort and returns toward baseline appropriately after ordinary stimulation.
column7: Creating fear/stress to demonstrate calming ability.

column3: For Best Trainer, review humane training, communication, progress and adaptation. For Best Comfort Buddy, review calm presence, boundaries, consistency and gentle companionship.
column6: Pattern appears across ordinary interactions rather than one unusually favorable moment.
column7: One photo/video, one exceptional day or one observer's personal impression.

column3: Five eligible reviewers score independently using the Legacy Universal Scoring Rule and the applicable Barclay's Choice rubric.

The five-vote Circle checks evidence sufficiency, material variance and whether human interpretation is consistent with the recorded behavior. The Circle cannot override welfare concerns to create a winner.
Verify calculations, eligibility, conflict/recusal, no-influence compliance and animal-welfare evidence. If Barclay's behavior is ambiguous or insufficient, the award may have no recipient.
Recognize the selected person only after final verification and consent. Preserve the decision record and learning without turning non-selection into blame.

column3: Required Role
Canine behavior / welfare reviewer
column4: Must be able to distinguish comfort, stress, avoidance and voluntary engagement.

column3: Training / handling subject-matter reviewer
column4: For Best Trainer, must understand humane dog-training practice; for Best Comfort Buddy, may be another canine-care reviewer.

column3: AMW Steward reviewer
column4: Applies Legacy safeguards, evidence discipline and conflict controls.

column3: Dave's Dog Center / Legacy community representative
column4: Understands ordinary setting/context but must be conflict-cleared and may not be a nominee.

column3: Rotating independent reviewer
column4: Reduces familiarity bias and reviews the same evidence independently.

column3: Selection Records Steward
column4: Maintains observations, scoring, conflicts, calculations and Return & Record; does not vote.

column1: A nominee cannot receive either Barclay's Choice award without credible evidence of Barclay's voluntary positive engagement and welfare. Human skill or affection alone is not enough. Barclay is never required to 'choose' someone. If his behavior is ambiguous, avoidant, stressed, inconsistent, or the evidence was materially influenced, the Choice Gate is not satisfied and the award may have no recipient.

Best Trainer and Best Comfort Buddy are distinct awards. The same person may be eligible for both only when separate evidence independently satisfies both rubrics. Winning one creates no presumption or bonus toward the other.
